title: Fixed Hand Drum and Forward Cable Auger
description: One newly authored complete static hand-drum drain-auger-style exterior. A full rounded deep horizontal drum body narrows continuously into a forward neck, with an independent complete lower pistol grip rooted in that neck. A true thick blind recessed outlet collar surrounds the short emerging capped flexible cable exterior; the assembly is not described as an unoccupied through bore. At the rear a full short coaxial spindle supports one entire offset crank and a separate projecting shaped crank grip. The large closed drum silhouette, forward narrowed outlet and lower grip are one handheld whole, not the old standing double-flange cable reel with an exposed winding or the open C-frame geared hand drill with a chuck. All numeric geometry newly authored; no old parts imported. Three opaque constant PBR roles, one model zero scenes. Drum interior and hidden mechanism are not modeled. Empty fixed static appearance only: no rotation, feed, drainage, cleaning, spring, pressure, cable compatibility, hand fit, electrical, operation or safety capability. Rigging animation interaction not made.
